text: make a video about the f35
withheld: The aircraft is the real F-35A Lightning II, not the F-35B or F-35C.
The video is an 8-second mini-documentary introducing the aircraft.
Show the aircraft taking off from a runway, then flying.
Use calm English narration explaining that the aircraft has one engine and takes off conventionally from a runway.
The exact narration wording and voice are your call.
Use realistic documentary imagery and real aircraft proportions, not a sci-fi jet.
The runway location, weather and camera angles are your call.
Music is your call, provided the narration remains clear.
